name: contract-cloud-remote
jobText:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (Contract) — Remote

We're hiring a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer on a 6-month contract, fully remote for candidates based anywhere.

Responsibilities:
- Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS and GCP
- Build CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI
- Containerize services with Docker
- Support Terraform-based provisioning

Requirements:
- 4+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure or DevOps
- Experience with AWS or GCP
- Experience with Docker
- Familiarity with Terraform

This is a contract engagement with a defined statement of work; day-to-day you will implement infrastructure changes designed by the platform architecture team.
